comment: The panel prints nothing but the module name and the maker named none of the controls, so every line is written from the code. Level knobs come up at zero and the mix knob at the centre (configParam defaults, src/MentalSubMixer.cpp:49-53), so a fresh instance is silent until the channel levels are raised. The pan law is linear with a factor of two, which puts unity at the centre and 6dB of lift on a hard-panned side; that is stated in the second note rather than as a decibel figure because the code carries the factor of two and no decibel constant.
